code_or_query:
import numpy as np
I=0.002
w_top=3150*2*np.pi/60
k_elec=0.00047
# at 22 m/s aero torque ~ scales V2: 0.12*(22/11)**2=0.48 Nm worst unloaded
T_aero=0.48
dt=0.005; t=np.arange(0,10,dt)
w=np.zeros_like(t); w[0]=w_top
for i in range(1,len(t)):
    T_e=T_aero-k_elec*w[i-1]
    w[i]=max(0,w[i-1]+T_e/I*dt)
print(f"elec-only w@10s rpm {w[-1]*60/2/np.pi:.0f} (target <315 rpm) -> FAILS, rotor runs away")
print(f"elec torque at top Nm {k_elec*w_top:.3f} vs aero Nm {T_aero:.2f}")
